{{Top|leg}}
'''Loyalty Inhibitors''' were hard-wired programs that were installed in [[Secretary droid/Legends|secretary droids]]. It prevented the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] from disclosing sensitive information to non-authorized personnel. The inhibitor could not be bypassed&mdash;any attempt to do so would result in circuitry overload and burnout.
